name: vibration isolation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过连接或支承措施降低振动传递的技术。

complete_examples.text: Finally, the method is applied to analyze soil vibrations, investigating the time- and frequency-domain characteristics of near- and far-field vibrations and quantitatively evaluating the effectiveness of different vibration isolation measures.

Finally, based on 2650188-2 16:54 WSPC/165-IJSSD 2650188 Substructure Coordination Method the proposed substructure coordination methods, the near/far field ground vibration distribution and the impact of the vibration isolation measurement are analyzed in detail.
